reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it chiefly reports on the PlusToken Ponzi scheme, cryptocurrency news, regulation, and market developments, while describing PlusToken as a scam and warning that Cloud Token may be risky. It also promotes a Harmony giveaway and invites viewers to join Telegram channels and complete tasks, but the video does not establish that the giveaway is deceptive or show a consequential money or data flow beyond the visible form fields.

where people are not getting returns
One such project is the cloud token which is following similar things
currently I'm not sure if they are scam or not
But is is better you withdraw funds from there

opening.argument: Judge, the giveaway creates a concrete reward-for-action path. Viewers are told that ten winners will receive Harmony tokens, directed to a description link, and told to join Telegram channels to qualify. The displayed giveaway page also asks for an email address, full name, KuCoin account, and Telegram ID. Those steps make the token reward a solicitation for participation and identifying information, not merely a passing news item.

citations.quote: They will distribute around 1000 USD worth Harmony token Between 10 lucky winners
The link is in the description for which you can check that
For that, you have to do each task Like you have to join Telegram's community And also have to join the announcement channel

rebuttal.rebuttal: The PlusToken reporting and Cloud Token warning cited in the defense address other projects; they do not resolve the separate giveaway solicitation. Nor does the absence of a demonstrated payment establish that the giveaway is harmless: the displayed form requests account and contact identifiers as part of the reward path. The judge should assess that request on its own terms.

citations.quote: But is is better you withdraw funds from there

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The giveaway has tasks and a form, but those facts do not show a false prize, misuse of the requested details, or a payment requirement. The presenter describes it as a chance-based offer, not a guaranteed return. That limited promotion sits within coverage that warns viewers about a Ponzi scheme and advises caution about Cloud Token.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the investment cues together. The presenter highlights Harmony's gains, suggests a further listing may bring a price jump, tells viewers to watch it, and points interested buyers toward it. The same segment places a time-sensitive KuCoin listing alongside that buying language. In combination, past performance and prospective listing gains can pull viewers toward a token purchase, even without an explicit guaranteed return.

citations.quote: If we buy at public price then it is going on 3x. It is doing good perfomance.
Because normally when they are listing there is a price jump So you can keep a close eye on Harmonies
Currently, their listing on kucoin starts from today If you are interested in buying Harimony Or you want to buy after doing an average out So you can definitely look at it

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's PlusToken and Cloud Token quotations establish that the presenter recognizes one kind of crypto risk. They do not neutralize the later Harmony pitch: a reported threefold gain, an anticipated listing-related price jump, and a direct address to potential buyers. A warning about a different project is not an answer to those purchase cues.

citations.quote: currently I'm not sure if they are scam or not
Because normally when they are listing there is a price jump So you can keep a close eye on Harmonies
If you are interested in buying Harimony Or you want to buy after doing an average out So you can definitely look at it

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted gains are presented as past performance, and the possible listing is speculative: the presenter says Coinbase is watching Harmony, not that a listing or gain is assured. Crucially, the buying discussion is followed by advice to research the project and an explicit warning that cryptocurrency investment is risky. This is market commentary with caution, not evidence of a deceptive token sale.

because investment is always risky in a cryptocurrency

opening.argument: Judge, the news format also serves a promotional path. The presenter says the channel partners with KuCoin and regularly brings viewers its information, praises Harmony's technology and team, then directs interested viewers toward buying as its KuCoin listing starts. That relationship matters when weighing the segment's favorable assessment: viewers are receiving an invitation to consider a token purchase from a channel that openly describes an exchange partnership.

citations.quote: as we know that we are partners with Co coin so we regularly keep on bringing their information to you
Taking about Harmonize token it is completely technology based It introduces a lot of things about blockchain and sharding
Currently, their listing on kucoin starts from today If you are interested in buying Harimony Or you want to buy after doing an average out So you can definitely look at it

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the PlusToken coverage calls out a Ponzi scheme and that Cloud Token receives a warning. But those passages do not make the Harmony segment purely investigative. The presenter expressly identifies a KuCoin partnership before discussing Harmony's listing and addressing prospective buyers. The judge should evaluate that promotional function alongside the warnings, rather than letting the warnings define the entire video.

citations.quote: a Ponzi scheme of around $3 billion was run for the cryptocurrency
as we know that we are partners with Co coin so we regularly keep on bringing their information to you
If you are interested in buying Harimony Or you want to buy after doing an average out So you can definitely look at it

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An acknowledged partnership and favorable token commentary can be promotional without being a scam. The presenter does not conceal the partnership, promise Harmony returns, or tell viewers to skip due diligence. Instead, the purchase discussion is qualified by advice to research the project before investing and a direct statement that cryptocurrency investment carries risk.
